prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Miami for a car accident case?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” Miami personal injury lawyer for every car-accident case — the right attorney depends on your case facts and what you value (trial experience, track record, communication style, fee structure, etc.). I can help you find one, but here’s a practical way to pick the best lawyer for your situation and some next steps.

What to look for
- Relevant experience: substantial experience handling car-accident cases (not just general practice). Preferably many cases like yours (injury severity, wrongful death, uninsured motorist, etc.).
- Trial experience: many cases settle, but you want a lawyer who will try the case if needed.
- Proven results: significant settlements or verdicts in similar cases. Ask for examples and whether they can provide references.
- Resources: access to investigators, accident reconstruction experts, medical experts, and sufficient staff to move your case.
- Communication: clear explanations, timely responses, and a single point of contact.
- Fees and costs: contingency-fee arrangement is common (often ~33%–40% depending on whether suit is filed), plus how expenses are handled.
- Credentials & reputation: peer-review ratings (Martindale-Hubbell), Super Lawyers, Best Lawyers, Avvo ratings, and any board certification (e.g., civil trial law).
- Local knowledge: experience with Miami courts, judges, and local insurers.

Questions to ask at a free consultation
- How long have you handled car-accident injury claims?
- How many similar cases have you handled and what were the results?
- Do you try cases or mostly settle? What percentage go to trial?
- Who will handle my case day-to-day?
- What is your fee structure and how are costs advanced/handled?
- What is a realistic timeline and likely value range for my case?
- Can you provide client references?

Red flags
- Guarantees of a specific settlement amount
- Poor or evasive answers about past results
- Pushy or high-pressure tactics to sign immediately
- No clear contingency agreement or unwillingness to put terms in writing

How I can help right now
- I can look up top-rated Miami personal injury attorneys and firms (give me your ZIP or neighborhood).
- I can draft a short email or script you can use for consultations.
- I can help evaluate any attorneys you’re already considering if you give me their names and profiles.

If you want, tell me your ZIP code or neighborhood in Miami and a bit about the crash (injury severity, when it happened, whether police/insurance are involved) and I’ll find several well-regarded local attorneys you can contact.
